title: Tobacco-specific alkaloid (TSA) formation in aged e-cigarette juices: mechanistic insights into hydroxyl radical-initiated nicotine oxidation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM01030F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xinyang Guo, Bradley H. Isenor, Kimberly Wong, James Davis, Arthur Chan, Ran Zhao
Nicotine in typical e-juice products can be oxidized during indoor storage, forming numerous tobacco-specific alkaloids (TSAs) when exposed to indoor environmental oxidants, such as OH radicals.
